result.brief: 提出 LIBERO-Pro2.0 具身基础模型鲁棒性基准，含 22 种静态扰动与 20 种运行时干预、1648 个偏移任务实例及 3.9 万条训练轨迹，并评测 17 个 VLA 与世界动作模型。
result.reason: Benchmark for robustness of embodied foundation models (VLA, world-action models) under distribution shifts; evaluates world-action models but contributes evaluation/data, not world modeling itself.
